health.title: Health Check
health.emptyDesc: Add or import passwords first, then come back for the health report.
health.allGood: Great — no password security issues found.
health.total: {count} entries in total · Computed locally, no network
health.reminderSet: Reminder set for "{username}" to change the password in {days} days
health.reuseHint: These accounts share the same password; one leak affects them all. Give each a unique password.
health.weakHint: These passwords are weak; increase length and mix upper/lowercase letters, numbers and symbols.
health.breachedHint: These passwords appear in a common breached-password dictionary (offline, no network) and are easy to brute-force. Change them immediately.
health.staleHint: These entries haven't been updated for a long time (based on last modified). Rotate important passwords regularly.
